title: Celery Juice Isn t Just Water
text: you'll hear out there the celery juice is mostly water this humble herb is much more than that people are missing the most powerful points of celery juice and what it knew he is celery juice is a hydro bioactive liquid this is a powerful healing herbal extraction sodium cluster salts antioxidants plant hormones vitamin C all of it suspends in a living form it's not just water it is a living mechanism that when you drink it it becomes you and it starts to heal the body I was once told that I had fibromyalgia chronic allergies sinus issues sleep issues hot flashes I started going to a variety of different doctors no one knew it was wrong with me I had other symptoms and nothing really helped very much when you're drinking celery juice you can taste the sodium cluster salts you can taste the medicinal qualities it has this is one aspect of the power of the medicine celery juice provides if somebody hasn't struggled or suffered in the symptom or condition that's chronic it's easy for them to say celery juice is all water and it can't be working it's knocking this remedy out of the hands of those who really need it and it's disrespectful to the growing number of people that already recover using celery juice it's telling them that their hard work and healing accomplishments never happened about a month after that I came across medical mediums book and decided to try the diet immediately I started feeling better a lot of my students have dissipated and I am feeling great as time has gone on I just keep getting better and better when we get sick the first thing we're told is to drink more water but water hasn't healed anyone who's been suffering with any kind of chronic illness but celery juice has I'm off all my medicine no symptoms and it's just a miracle this is healing you can all heal [Music]
